It is entirely different. This mod only adds the possibility for bosses to spawn on maps where they are not supposed to spawn. For example Tagilla is supposed to spawn of Factory right? With this mod, you get a chance to encounter him on ANY map; such as Interchange, Customs, Woods… This mod does not control waves like ABPS, just spawns at the start of the raid.

You can customize in the config if you want to add the bosses in ADDITION of the max number of bots set up by ABPS or your locations/map configs or to respect the maxbot amount.

This mod only touches bosses and their guard escorts, no PMC, no SCAVS, no SNIPERS, no RAIDERS/ROGUES/SMUGGLERS/CULTISTS…

If you have more questions, don’t hesitate.

comments.author: spt123123
comments.body_html: If I use the Boss Notifier mod, will it track boss movement? I want to avoid a scenario where Glukhar spawns at Dorms and the alert pins him there, yet I end up running into him at the Gas Station. I use the SAIN。

comments.author: Wrath_Jr
comments.body_html:
Bosses Extravaganza does overlap with ABPS in the sense that both can affect boss spawns. However, ABPS is a broad bot placement framework that controls many aspects of raid population: PMCs, scavs, waves, boss entries, zones and bot behavior.

My mod is more focused: it only adds extra vanilla boss encounters on top of existing vanilla/modded spawns, with a simple per-map/per-boss config, a cap on additional bosses, boss-tier logic, zone validation, and gameplay-oriented restrictions for heavy bosses.

So if you already use ABPS and want to manually configure everything, there is some overlap. If you want a dedicated “more bosses, intelligently placed” mod without managing the entire bot ecosystem, my mod is the simpler option, and you could use both, placing my mod lower in the load order so it does it’s thing and ABPS keeps taking care of everything exept aditionnal bosses

One more thing I have worked on on this mod is to preven ghost bosses (sometimes they spawn in impossible locations so you simply don’t see them even if the mod “boss notifier’ says they’re there. I have implemented 3 classes of bosses (heavy, medium, and solos) and they all have a custom ruleset for spawns (example, Kaban and Glukhar with their big squad will never spawn in loose aeras on custom, but will defend the scav base (fortress) , as you don’t wanto to encounter a 10 man elite squad in the wild or in bushes (tho glukhar guars will still roam around the map as it’s intended in their AI)

Hope you can see the differences now. Both mods would work fine together but mine should take control of the boss spawn as it is entirely focused on it.

comments.author: Wrath_Jr
comments.body_html: Boss notifier will not do that This is Dynamic maps that you want for this, and with this mod, the answer is yes. Tho I recommend using all three mods together. Extravaganza, Dynamic Maps, and Boss Notifiers. (be aware to disable things you don’t want to see on the map in the f12 menu of dynamic maps to spare your performances)
